visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an outdoor establishing shot of a Lawson convenience store in Japan. A large cherry blossom tree with bright pink flowers is in full bloom in the foreground, framing the left side of the frame against a backdrop of modern high-rise office buildings. Large pink and blue text overlays appear in the center of the frame. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor retail environment at FamilyMart. A hand with neatly trimmed nails reaches into an open freezer chest and selects a small, white yogurt ice cream cup. Pink and white text blocks with numerical labels are positioned at the top and bottom of the frame over the freezer view. (3) The focus moves to a shelf filled with Black Thunder brand chocolate snacks. A hand picks up a black and yellow packaged chocolate sandwich bar. White and red variety-style text boxes appear at the bottom, following the hand movements as it holds the snacks. The shot cuts to the hand holding an unwrapped bar. (4) The narrative continues at FamilyMart featuring a Pierre Hermé collaboration. A hand picks up a brown and gold bag containing a coffee-flavored chocolate cake. A large pink text banner is visible at the top, while an inset square graphic appears briefly in the lower right corner showing a macaron sandwich. (5) The video transitions to a 7-Eleven store shelf. A hand holds a blue bag of chocolate-covered marshmallow snacks. A translucent white text box with black characters is overlaid at the bottom, accompanied by a small graphic of the snack's interior showing a soft, white marshmallow core center. (6) A hand displays a dark-colored bag of Calbee brand potato chips with a fried rice flavor, found at 7-Eleven. The background consists of brightly lit store shelves densely packed with various colorful snack products. A pink text label with a number is at the top left, while white subtitles are centered. (7) At a Lawson store, the camera focuses on a display of Morinaga brand Mister Donut chocolate biscuit sticks. The packaging is yellow and brown, featuring images of the biscuit sticks. A blue and white brand logo banner is at the top, and smaller white text captions appear near the bottom. (8) The final product featured is a yellow carton of Lemon Water for Meat Eaters from Morinaga Milk. A hand picks up the carton from a refrigerated shelf among other bottled juices. The yellow and blue text overlay persists at the top, while descriptive white captions are placed over the lower third. (9) The video concludes with a graphic outro on a bright pink background. A large circular logo for Japanuts is centered, surrounded by social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. Large white and pink graphical icons representing social media platforms are distributed across the central pink background frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track is a continuous, studio-quality master of upbeat electronic pop music from start to finish. The composition features a high-tempo rhythmic foundation with a steady 4/4 electronic kick drum and crisp percussion at approximately 128 BPM. Bright, cheerful synthesizer melodies in a major key lead the harmonic structure, creating a high-arousal and positive mood throughout the duration. There are no human voices, dialogue, or background chatter, nor are there any audible environmental noises from the store settings or physical sound effects like rustling or clicks. The frequency balance is bright with a prominent spectral weight in the higher frequencies, and the dynamic range is relatively compressed to ensure a consistent and energetic sound suitable for short-form video montage. The entire track maintains pristine technical clarity with no distortion, clipping, or digital artifacts.
